# arin_delegation (Data Source)

Read reverse DNS nameservers, TTLs, and DNSSEC DS records for an existing delegation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
data "arin_delegation" "example" {
  name = "0.5.0.8.f.2.0.6.2.ip6.arpa."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Reverse delegation name, such as a name ending in in-addr.arpa or ip6.arpa.

### Read-Only

- `ds_records` (Attributes List) ds records returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ds_records))
- `nameservers` (Attributes List) nameservers returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nameservers))

<a id="nestedatt--ds_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ds_records`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (Number) algorithm returned by ARIN.
- `algorithm_name` (String) algorithm name returned by ARIN.
- `digest` (String) digest returned by ARIN.
- `digest_type` (Number) digest type returned by ARIN.
- `digest_type_name` (String) digest type name returned by ARIN.
- `key_tag` (Number) key tag returned by ARIN.
- `ttl` (Number) ttl returned by ARIN.


<a id="nestedatt--nameservers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nameservers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
- `ttl` (Number) ttl returned by ARIN.
